ns2:course.label: Entrepreneurial Finance
ns2:course.description: The study of the financial side of entrepreneurial firms, including alternative methods of organization, sources of financing, use of financial statements as a management tool, financial planning, valuation methods, and exit strategies, all from the perspective of an owner, CEO or CFO. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FIN 300 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FIN 300 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Finance or Finance + Data Science major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: 7-8 sessions in lieu of regular class sessions will be held on Tuesday or Wednesday evenings.
